Observe learns Super unless explicitly refused. It learns Alt only when ALT is unset and protocol flags are active or the key code is outside Char, Esc, Enter, Backspace, Tab, and BackTab. Final hint delivery separately uses cached Alt policy and explicit refusal. No terminal behavior was proved.

Keep at most 64 retained items in this collection. Append preserves existing items before incoming retained items, then saturating-adds the prior dropped count. Dropped is cumulative usize saturation, not capped at 64; exact totals are unavailable beyond usize::MAX. Documentation correction only.
